title: Multi-View Transformer with Geometry-Guided Multi-Modal ControlNet for 3D Virtual Try-On
abstract: arXiv:2611.25979v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Editing a 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS) capture of a person so that they wear a new garment requires every rendered view to agree on the same garment details. Existing 3D virtual try-on (VTON) pipelines, however, edit training views largely independently and fuse them with hand-designed heuristics such as manually chosen reference views and fixed attention-blending weights. The resulting inconsistencies are baked into the 3D representation and surface as texture drift, blurred prints, and implausible geometry in novel views. We present GS-VTON-MVT, a three-stage framework that combines implicit and explicit 3D reasoning for consistent 3DGS try-on. translated_title: 面向3D虚拟试穿的多视图Transformer与几何引导多模态ControlNet
translated_abstract: 编辑一个人的3D高斯泼溅（3DGS）捕捉以使其穿上新服装，要求每个渲染视图在相同的服装细节上保持一致。然而，现有的3D虚拟试穿（VTON）流程在很大程度上独立地编辑各个训练视图，并依靠手工设计的启发式方法（如手动选择的参考视图和固定的注意力混合权重）来融合它们。由此产生的不一致性被固化到3D表示中，在新视角下表现为纹理漂移、印花模糊以及不合理的几何形状。我们提出了GS-VTON-MVT，这是一个结合隐式与显式3D推理以实现一致性3DGS试穿的三阶段框架。（i）多视图修补Transformer通过完整的跨视图自注意力机制联合编辑一组训练视图，使跨视图对应关系得以学习而非人为强加。（ii）几何引导的多模态ControlNet将扩散编辑器以服装图像以及……（原文摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 该论文提出GS-VTON-MVT三阶段框架，通过具备完整跨视图自注意力的多视图修补Transformer学习视图间对应关系，并利用几何引导的多模态ControlNet对扩散编辑器进行条件控制，从而实现视角一致、细节保真的3D高斯泼溅虚拟试穿。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes GS-VTON-MVT, a three-stage framework that leverages a multi-view inpainting transformer with full cross-view self-attention and a geometry-guided multi-modal ControlNet to achieve view-consistent, detail-faithful 3D Gaussian Splatting virtual try-on.
